name: ATK_TECH_HARVEST_REQUEST_JOBS
description: ATK_TECH_HARVEST_REQUEST_JOBS contains the latest request job status for the full assets harvest and new assets harvest.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier of the harvest request job.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies the batch within a request id

columns.name: TECH_ASSETS_XML
columns.description: Represents the technology assets xml to be loaded into the asset tables

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: Identifies the status of the harvest job such as IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED or FAILED.

columns.name: PROCESS_START
columns.description: Identifies the start time of the harvest request job.

columns.name: PROCESS_END
columns.description: Identifies the finish time of the harvest request job.

columns.name: PROCESS_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the type of harvest request such as full or new assets harvest.

columns.name: LAST_HARVEST_DATE
columns.description: The date when the asset was last harvested

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
